integrity: The proof includes explicit support-functional witnesses, an infinite-dimensional LUR proof, the local-symmetry lemma, strict nonattainment, a duality transfer, and elementary exponential-limit bounds. A standalone standard-library checker tests finite exponents and does not serve as an infinite proof. Independent auditing and validation have not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns a specific equivalent real Hilbert norm and its dual. Uniform convexity is not asserted, and the usual Hilbert norm remains fully symmetric. A generic infinite-dimensional smooth non-C-symmetry example was known in 2018; only the stronger LUR/Hilbert-equivalent dual and two locally uniform direction conditions plus the explicit nonattainment rate are claimed. The full 2018 defining predecessor was inaccessible and may already imply some strengthened statements.
title: A locally uniformly rotund Hilbert renorming with maximal nonattained \(C\)-symmetry defect
